name: Wordz
author: chris (spec) / orchestrator (implementation)
description: Wordz. Clue: a string of 3-6 digits. Solution: a sequence of that many English words (whitespace-separated) where word i has, alternately, exactly digit-i VOWELS (i even: positions 0,2,4..) or exactly digit-i CONSONANTS (i odd). Vowels are a e i o u; y is a consonant. E.g. 3559 -> 'Potato Breaking Hippopotamus Transformation' (3 vowels, 5 consonants, 5 vowels, 9 consonants). Words are checked against words.WORDS (web2 + common list). generate() draws random common words and emits their alternating counts (digits 1-9 only). solve() picks a random common word per digit. Human-designed.
